findings.summary: The NO_HTTP/NO_CLOUD denylists are hand-written group prefixes, not a derivation from architecture.md rule 5, so the gate is a floor rather than a proof: a banned dependency whose coordinates match no listed group (e.g. a non-netty, non-httpcomponents HTTP client such as org.eclipse.jetty or a repackaged shaded client) passes silently.
findings.failure_scenario: Add a jetty-client or square.okhttp dependency to the `ingest` module: the module-boundary rule is violated, the build compiles, every test passes, and check-module.sh reports ok because neither coordinate appears in the denylisted group prefixes. Nothing in the gate fails and no other check covers it.
